model:
tff('declare_$i1',type,'fmb_$i_1':$i).
tff('declare_$i2',type,'fmb_$i_2':$i).
tff('finite_domain_$i',axiom,
      ! [X:$i] : (
         X = 'fmb_$i_1' | X = 'fmb_$i_2'
      ) ).

tff('distinct_domain_$i',axiom,
         'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_2'
).

tff(declare_pair1,type,pair1:$i).
tff(pair1_definition,axiom,pair1 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_nonzero,type,nonzero:$i).
tff(nonzero_definition,axiom,nonzero = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_pair2,type,pair2:$i).
tff(pair2_definition,axiom,pair2 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_sum_pair,type,sum_pair:$i).
tff(sum_pair_definition,axiom,sum_pair = 'fmb_$i_2').
tff(declare_wronskian,type,wronskian: ($i * $i) > $o).
tff(predicate_wronskian,axiom,
           wronskian('fmb_$i_1','fmb_$i_1')
         & wronskian('fmb_$i_1','fmb_$i_2')
         & ~wronskian('fmb_$i_2','fmb_$i_1')
         & ~wronskian('fmb_$i_2','fmb_$i_2')

).
